_source: Measured from published images of the device: false-coloured and bare micrographs of the die in A. Wallraff, lecture slides (UCLA, May 2025), https://polybox.ethz.ch/index.php/s/CnsHoKWW6xQKZAA. Device: S. Krinner, N. Lacroix et al., Nature 605, 669 (2022). Coordinates in mm, origin at qubit D5, x right, y up. Scale calibrated on the 1 mm launchpad pitch; image resolution ~7.5 um/px. Lines are traced centerlines.

capacitors._note: Gap widths are below the image resolution (<= 12 um); centerline spacings are measured to ~+-1.5 um. A 10 um gap fits every measured spacing, and metal = centerline spacing - gap.
